description:
• About our brand and products: BIGGYMBRO is a premium gym apparel brand built for the aesthetic-bodybuilding generation — from those just starting their journey to the ones already deep in it. We specialize in heavyweight 220-285gsm 100% cotton oversized graphic tees and pump covers, finished with a washed aesthetic and bold graphic prints rooted in classical and Baroque art. Founded in France, now shipping across Europe, the US, UK, Canada, and Australia. Average order value €60-70, with most customers purchasing bundles.


• What makes us different:  Most gym wear brands compete on cheap synthetic fabrics and forgettable prints. We don't. Every BIGGYMBRO piece is 100% heavyweight cotton — no polyester, no synthetic blends, ever. Our prints aren't just graphics slapped on a tee — they're high-grade prints that bond into the fabric itself, holding up wash after wash without cracking or fading. Each design is an original artwork, drawing on Greek statues, Latin typography, Baroque chiaroscuro, and discipline-driven symbolism. The fit is engineered, not generic: aesthetic oversized cuts that drop the shoulder, gather under pull, and frame the physique. Our customers feel the weight, see the art, and recognise the craft — and they buy bundles, not single pieces


• How affiliates can earn: 

  • 20% commission on every referral order — no minimums, no earnings cap, every sale counted regardless of size
  • Flexible payouts: monthly or bi-weekly, your choice
  • No minimum threshold before your first payout — when you earn, you get paid
  • Dual-channel tracking via your unique affiliate link + your personal coupon code (so attribution never depends on cookies)
  • Personal 25% welcome discount + free shipping on your first order to represent the brand in your own pieces
  • Tier-based growth: higher commission rates, free pieces from new collections, and partner-only drops unlock as you grow with us


• How to promote us: Promote BIGGYMBRO wherever your audience lives — Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, your own platform, your community. Our brand resonates strongest with serious gym culture, the aesthetic-bodybuilding generation, classical/discipline-driven content, and masculine-coded fitness audiences aged 18-30. We don't dictate scripts, hashtags, or posting schedules. What matters is content quality and message alignment with the brand. Strong content formats: physique-and-pieces videos, gym session clips, fit checks, classical-aesthetic stills

• Other information:


• Other information: Applications are reviewed personally within 1-3 days — no bots, no mass approvals. We work with a curated group of partners and invest deeply in those who invest in us. The longer you stand with us, the more opens up: higher commission tiers, partner-only collections, free pieces, priority on collaboration opportunities, and a direct line to the founder, not a support inbox. We're scaling across Europe, the US, and beyond — early partners get the best position to grow with the brand.
payout_period: monthly payouts on the 15th of each month
